hero.sub: AnimeCaos brings anime search, playback and downloads into one app. Track your lists on AniList and MyAnimeList, and share what you are watching on Discord.

features.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
features.sub: AniList and MyAnimeList trackers, Discord presence, a clean player and offline downloads.

items.title: Smart Hub
items.desc: Unified search across multiple Brazilian sources in a single query.

items.title: Clean Player
items.desc: Powered by mpv — lightweight, ad-free, no popups, no slowdowns.

items.title: AniList + MyAnimeList
items.desc: Track your progress, mark watched episodes and keep your lists up to date from the app.

items.title: Auto-Play
items.desc: Detects the end of an episode and automatically plays the next one. Watch as many as you want.

items.title: Offline Download
items.desc: Download any episode in the background with real-time progress via yt-dlp.

items.title: Standalone
items.desc: The Windows installer includes the player and required components, with no external dependencies.

download.title: Ready to start?
download.sub: A complete Windows installer with all components included and no external dependencies.
download.note: No need to install Python, mpv or yt-dlp. The Windows setup includes all required components.
download.linux_sub: Download and run on x86_64 Linux distributions.
download.linux_note: Supports x86_64 Linux. Make the AppImage executable before opening it.
download.mac_note: Requires Python 3.10+ to install from source.
download.cta_sub: Available for Windows, macOS and Linux.

about.title: A new chapter, built with Go.
about.p1: AnimeCaos 3.0.0 is the first public release after the rewrite: a desktop app to discover and watch anime, organize your library, and read manga.
about.p2: The app was rebuilt with Go and Wails 2. Its interface uses React and TypeScript, while core features now run in the Go backend. The previous Python code remains under Legacy/ and is not part of the distributed app.
about.legacy_note: The distributed app does not depend on the legacy Python project.
about.anime_desc: Search across sources, seasons, episodes, MPV playback, My List, history, and downloads.
about.manga_desc: MangaDex catalog, continuous or paged reading, and chapters to download as CBZ files.
about.integrations_desc: AniList sync and optional Discord presence. First-time MyAnimeList login is still being validated in v3.0.0.
about.distribution_desc: Windows x64 and Linux x86_64 packages include media and browser runtimes.
about.open_desc: The repository is public on GitHub. The current app runs on Go; the previous Python version is preserved under Legacy/. Issues, contributions, and forks are welcome.

howto.title: How to Use
howto.sub: Four steps. Five minutes. Anime playing.

steps.title: Download AnimeCaos
steps.desc: On Windows, download and run the complete installer. It includes the required components and needs no external tools.

steps.title: Search for an Anime
steps.desc: Type the name in the search box. Fuzzy search finds the title even with typos.

steps.title: Select the Episode
steps.desc: Choose a source and episode. The app shows the cover and synopsis and connects your progress with AniList and MyAnimeList.

steps.title: Watch or Download
steps.desc: Click Play to open in mpv, or Download to save in the background to ~/Downloads/Animecaos.
